| 279 | el_e89dce562ef649a6ab5b1b63bc675be1 | text | sec_0ef997092dde4716b2d813d720690985 | 12 | All EU-certified engines delivered by Rolls-Royce Solutions come with a second nameplate. This second nameplate is delivered "loosely" with the engine. If th... |

| 284 | el_76a0a618320a432e8763e10c72c8252f | text | sec_04b7d5127c39439b833215f57feb1d06 | 13 | The product is intended for use in accordance with its contractually-defined purpose as described in the relevant technical documents only. |

| 292 | el_923d3420536d4efbbaa4f2223a935416 | list_item | sec_04b7d5127c39439b833215f57feb1d06 | 13 | Work which requires communication with the control units must only be carried out with a diagnosis software or with tools approved by the manufacturer. |
| 293 | el_6c2449316c234b42a74441c247a88d29 | list_item | sec_04b7d5127c39439b833215f57feb1d06 | 13 | In compliance with the maintenance work and intervals specified in the (→ Maintenance Schedule) throughout the useful life of the product |
| 294 | el_64190c60bb7242179938ee946b8344fb | list_item | sec_04b7d5127c39439b833215f57feb1d06 | 13 | In compliance with the maintenance and repair instructions contained in this manual, in particular with regard to the specified tightening torques |
| 295 | el_abc99900c93a4d528ba85ea16de32a04 | list_item | sec_04b7d5127c39439b833215f57feb1d06 | 13 | With appropriate safety guards covering all rotating and power transmitting components in accordance with applicable accident prevention regulations |
| 296 | el_bad869c87280484aa071d31594dd6e44 | list_item | sec_04b7d5127c39439b833215f57feb1d06 | 13 | With the exclusive use of technical personnel trained in commissioning, operation, maintenance and repair |

| 310 | el_3123715e8fe34977a4369e3d3d6b9912 | text | sec_b3b26deeab58480fbb361ce87e9fc8b3 | 14 | This manual must be issued to all personnel involved in operation, maintenance, repair, assembly, installation, or transportation. |
| 311 | el_37079a60a18547099e879647f4301035 | text | sec_b3b26deeab58480fbb361ce87e9fc8b3 | 14 | Keep this manual handy in the vicinity of the product such that it is accessible to operating, maintenance, repair, assembly, installation, and transport per... |
| 312 | el_18a91378a92e4e50b084c7a4dee70f59 | text | sec_b3b26deeab58480fbb361ce87e9fc8b3 | 14 | Personnel must receive instruction on product handling and repair based on this manual. In particular, personnel must have read and understood the safety req... |
| 313 | el_dce46e5f680a415183805d802b2edd0c | text | sec_b3b26deeab58480fbb361ce87e9fc8b3 | 14 | This is important in the case of personnel who only occasionally perform work on or around the product. Such personnel must be instructed repeatedly. |
| 314 | el_d8f5d681d8ad48fe9514db110b6d1c3c | section_header | sec_b4738d0120cc481180b22f84255bcb16 | 14 | Personnel requirements |
| 315 | el_f6c9209aebb8479a928f1b542140fd1c | text | sec_b4738d0120cc481180b22f84255bcb16 | 14 | All work on the product must be carried out by trained, instructed and qualified personnel only: |
| 316 | el_b6857c90f044449db0b3318dfdd43d2f | list_item | sec_b4738d0120cc481180b22f84255bcb16 | 14 | Qualified personnel from the areas mechanical engineering, plant construction, and electrical engineering and also for work with live parts |
| 317 | el_f95cb9d14d864e5c8152e9bb5928b35e | list_item | sec_b4738d0120cc481180b22f84255bcb16 | 14 | Training at the Training Center of the manufacturer |
| 318 | el_ae4607f4f0db4132a5791ee5a64e8688 | text | sec_b4738d0120cc481180b22f84255bcb16 | 14 | The operator must define the responsibilities of the personnel involved in operation, maintenance, repair, assembly, installation, and transport in writing. |
| 319 | el_ce9c702639bc496684d8c03eb120d794 | text | sec_b4738d0120cc481180b22f84255bcb16 | 14 | Personnel shall not report for duty under the influence of alcohol, drugs or strong medication. |
| 320 | el_12385977fde446e8bc4f8d0935292a8a | section_header | sec_774d8e9593b44662818c012995ca7e97 | 14 | Clothing and personal protective equipment |
| 321 | el_70c307c47b694881b7932a1b0f6569ad | text | sec_774d8e9593b44662818c012995ca7e97 | 14 | Always wear appropriate personal protective equipment, e.g. safety shoes, ear protectors, protective gloves, goggles, breathing mask. Follow the instructions... |
| 322 | el_f22ca132a00e45b29769ea9906783c37 | text | sec_774d8e9593b44662818c012995ca7e97 | 14 | When working on live components, in particular on electrical switchgear or on high-voltage component, wear special protective clothing according to IEC 61482. |
| 323 | el_43f15c1a7a8249149543c13c27694aa3 | text | sec_774d8e9593b44662818c012995ca7e97 | 14 | Safe handling of Substances of Very High Concern pursuant to the REACH regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and restriction of CHemicals): We... |
| 324 | el_cfc172ca1d1144b9b8cd6dcf289136e3 | section_header | sec_2ca51554c1d041a398c2b0062493ed41 | 15 | 2.4 Safety regulations for commissioning and operation |
| 325 | el_35f3dce553cb4036a57efa5641a45642 | section_header | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | Safety regulations for commissioning |
| 326 | el_769cdd9bed724a2b9ea0075e35b7125c | text | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | Install the product correctly and carry out acceptance in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications before commissioning the product. All necessary a... |
| 327 | el_3848b3ff978c461aba38e28bf81f091f | text | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | Whenever the product is subsequently put into operation ensure that: |
| 328 | el_a3d5109a8e304962b3b9af4f55284f7d | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | All maintenance and repair work has been completed. |
| 329 | el_e962c8bec2634f2eb87c1b0351ec0ec1 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | All personnel is clear of the danger zone surrounding moving parts of the machine. Electrically-actuated linkages may be set in motion when the Engine Contro... |
| 330 | el_7eb9a0d97dd3456199de5772616f695c | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | All loose parts have been removed from rotating machine components. |
| 331 | el_d9433c11a4e74ddd8488f8f79cb48f8b | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | All lines bearing media are ready for operation. |
| 332 | el_2b1c6621997444feadaef0c1e0181a8f | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | All protective devices are in place. |
| 333 | el_0c28cd16856f41569440c3e59f2ebfe9 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | The walkways in the operating room are unobstructed and safe. |
| 334 | el_d3a8b1589c074f408de6bb214bdbd5be | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | The operating room is adequately ventilated in all operating states. |
| 335 | el_d9055432d0c84006a2730468866765bc | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | No persons wearing pacemakers or any other active implanted medical devices (AIMD) are present. |
| 336 | el_29be0f06a85f490fb0f77414af7dccf8 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | In the first few hours of operation, the product emits gases as a result of smoldering e.g. lacquers or oil. These gases may be hazardous to health. Always w... |
| 337 | el_cd7d1e9da8824d4598c62c8c738d5f57 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | The product is entirely free of damage, this applies in particular to lines and cabling. |
| 338 | el_afb854fcd74d406b91d33fed62706372 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | The exhaust pipework is leak-tight and the gases are vented to atmosphere. |
| 339 | el_c9a09c9e3ece4cb79a83e2d5a279ba98 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | All components are properly grounded. Ground separately by means of a grounding stake as necessary. |
| 340 | el_c86a6b9c9e18452ba6260b819e0eba72 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | Battery terminals, generator terminals or cables are protected against accidental contact. |
| 341 | el_86ef2bdc0d6b486098cb1834ef2f4517 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | The power supply (mains plug) is always freely accessible to facilitate disconnecting the device or system from the power supply at any time. |
| 342 | el_881e87b8733f484b824fe6ec1d176a29 | list_item | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | All connections have been correctly allocated e.g. +/- polarity, fuel line/reducing agent line, supply/return. |
| 343 | el_1d2eb3d52a5d444ca32198f00eacffcf | text | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | Immediately after putting the product into operation, make sure that all control and display instruments as well as the monitoring, signaling and alarm syste... |
| 344 | el_dc9047e6fb6c49c48a459d0a70a171fc | text | sec_f1d25ccef3954cebbf84e28772ce6470 | 15 | Smoking is prohibited in the vicinity of the product. |
| 345 | el_2384c9940aff4d86a2f878d4a21a3b67 | section_header | sec_2dfd6ccfcf0a496ab9316c13386776d4 | 15 | Safety regulations during operation |
| 346 | el_5ccfa245329c4a09aeead81bc6380eaa | text | sec_2dfd6ccfcf0a496ab9316c13386776d4 | 15 | The operator must be familiar with the controls and displays. |
| 347 | el_e23e1588f45e4590a8a388dadac5c6a2 | text | sec_2dfd6ccfcf0a496ab9316c13386776d4 | 15 | The operator must be familiar with the consequences of any operations performed. |
| 348 | el_75a059d4fbe1461aa9d5018f0082c8ad | text | sec_2dfd6ccfcf0a496ab9316c13386776d4 | 15 | During operation, the display instruments and monitoring units must be observed with regard to present operating status, violation of limit values, and warni... |
| 349 | el_44eb80e553e04073a6c867073ea6d008 | section_header | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | Malfunctions and emergency stop |
| 350 | el_fd4ed4a1bcca46a0931c8f264fb667d7 | text | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | Practice emergency procedures, especially emergency stopping, at regular intervals. |
| 351 | el_dfed5c60c9f146bc83bff5ba07a7e595 | text | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | Proceed as follows if any system malfunctions are detected or signaled by the system: |
| 352 | el_06a94f55bf4c457a8aebfa951d67981c | list_item | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | Analyze the message. |
| 353 | el_81320d34c27f427994c51a8af2fc59e0 | list_item | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | Inform supervisor(s) in charge. |
| 354 | el_466edf177b8d45f09defca4b884fc2f7 | list_item | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | Respond by taking any necessary emergency action, e.g. emergency stop. |
| 355 | el_b678ae5792034398bb3d1c60b3ab1bb3 | text | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | After a safety shutdown, the engine may only be started after the cause of the shutdown has been eliminated. |
| 356 | el_beae465ad4ec4fc58985f4ecece50df0 | text | sec_0508945a48ad43b49ca9711340f8750e | 15 | Contact Service if the root cause of the malfunction cannot be clearly identified. |
| 357 | el_efa44f66004d45dfbed2b4dbde64b125 | section_header | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 15 | Operation |
| 358 | el_2fc401e68a6b48beae31ab86e5bcb1a0 | text | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 15 | Do not remain in the operating room when the product is running unless absolutely necessary. Keep your stay as short as possible. |
| 359 | el_4cb2f04c50c04eb5b678eeea67754eed | text | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 15 | In applications with potentially fluctuating gas qualities, stay away from the engine during start-up. |
| 360 | el_3c981eadbd2f495899bbc656596e6127 | text | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 15 | \| |
| 361 | el_1b7c5295fcab41489830ec532602f4ab | text | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 16 | \| |
| 362 | el_32e8f85e837a4a09b86e115b625b8881 | text | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 16 | Keep a safe distance away from the product if possible. Do not touch the product unless expressly instructed to do so following a written procedure. |
| 363 | el_f4fe37fe50f245ac9c91b03a95ee922c | text | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 16 | Do not inhale exhaust gases emitted by the product. |
| 364 | el_55872a97074142cf94ee056fb792f681 | text | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 16 | The following requirements must be fulfilled before the product is started: |
| 365 | el_1a8f8d334a1941349b4927604bd0fb83 | list_item | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 16 | Mop up any leaked or spilled fluids and lubricants immediately or soak up with a suitable binding agent. |
| 366 | el_34c16d347e2e4074adb6016c83a90a1c | list_item | sec_4786fd86bd054b05968af8e812b2594f | 16 | Wear hearing protection. |
| 367 | el_2669a95b910a4aacb34ac82fdb8c810c | section_header | sec_42c220086fc743b386c0f2cdf0402003 | 16 | Operation of electrical equipment |
| 368 | el_8ab7982f5fbe4f50baa45ae819e4a44e | text | sec_42c220086fc743b386c0f2cdf0402003 | 16 | Some appliances or parts of the electrical system are electrically live (high voltage) in operation. |
| 369 | el_68ed4983e3964ee6821371b47b3e36b0 | text | sec_42c220086fc743b386c0f2cdf0402003 | 16 | Follow the applicable operating and safety instructions when operating the appliances and heed warnings at all times. |
| 370 | el_32d9133fd83d49ceacd083292312f2b0 | section_header | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | 2.5 Safety regulations for assembly, maintenance, and repair work |
| 371 | el_5fd351f4e6914f5b8dcfe534247a4923 | section_header | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Safety regulations for work prior to assembly, maintenance and repair |
| 372 | el_fddf95693a0c43f6b74b9e85514f217b | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Have assembly, maintenance or repair work carried out by qualified and authorized personnel only. |
| 373 | el_cb7e08f756774431a26bb6570267f495 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Allow the product to cool down to less than 50 °C (risk of explosion from oil vapors, fluids and lubricants, risk of burning/scalding). |
| 374 | el_64a758eddd4b4f94a1b82d6bc15ca2d7 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Relieve pressure in fluid and lubricant systems and compressed-air lines which are to be opened. Use suitable containers of adequate capacity to catch fluids... |
| 375 | el_7a3dc953b8d54525a6c6daf1b12c5e45 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Release residual pressure before removing a component in the supply line. To depressurize pressurized lines, shut off lines first, then release residual pres... |
| 376 | el_d51a3580a47644e6aef4f9c765d567fa | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Work may only be carried out on lines when they are free of fluids and lubricants. |
| 377 | el_5fe79444744e44f581a25748074da407 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Ensure adequate ventilation of the operating room when carrying out an oil change, working on the gaseous/ liquid fuel system or working with process materia... |
| 378 | el_a35e29433dd147a387a672a7f5890d31 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Never carry out assembly, maintenance, or repair work with the product in operation, unless: |
| 379 | el_e8fc57219dc14fdc8b4bbdcfd75c68f9 | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Expressly permitted to do so following a written procedure. |
| 380 | el_ee7a797634e54f9ba8413c838b7f7e4e | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Secure the product to preclude undesired starting (LOTO), e.g. |
| 381 | el_95b55aaf960c417589b8d6f24df53b2e | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Key switch |
| 382 | el_853738d0ba17448c90aa45430d810760 | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Start interlock |
| 383 | el_26d875741d77463596a53610a820301d | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Close supply line for hydraulic starting |
| 384 | el_4f051d398d0c4b94b36681b4abf1f2d3 | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Close main valve on compressed-air system and vent compressed-air line when air starters are fitted. |
| 385 | el_6397d07ab07b42be90c39cb9a21e9b4a | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Attach a 'Do not operate' sign in the operating area or on control equipment. |
| 386 | el_d77c2520f17046b985bf16af46aefe38 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Disconnect battery cables or actuate the battery isolator switch, if applicable. Lockout circuit breakers. |
| 387 | el_2a300f43e5db4b6594fba79f77bdea56 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Before starting work on CaPoS, if applicable: |
| 388 | el_9dc240b8197b4f5e8fc4aee72f1e12bf | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Discharge UltraCap modules using appropriate discharger |
| 389 | el_7cd8ce8259ac44dea42fadf13b9bfcf6 | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Switch off charging system (DC/DC converter) |
| 390 | el_6dbde26584d741598f19ba93a3fdc45d | list_item | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Short-circuit UltraCap modules with a suitable wire jumper |
| 391 | el_33b10ab5b1334b9a825aa8b0add6fafb | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Before working on the exhaust gas aftertreatment system, close the shut-off valve on the reducing agent tank. Note that reducing agent pumps continue to run... |
| 392 | el_5a703dd78d7f48f0b65ada830ab2eb1d | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Disconnect control equipment from product. |
| 393 | el_1cd41e3a65964e3c9a8cc06bb031e728 | text | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Use recommended special tools or suitable equivalents when instructed to do so. |
| 394 | el_cd7f67ce04e94cb1988d9a19ce830bc8 | section_header | sec_2a81bbd3e0ee4e75bc1917d14edb59e6 | 17 | Safety regulations when performing assembly, maintenance and repair work |
| 395 | el_99950f5ffc044bc7a58729884170968a | section_header | sec_0d69ca7fb6f24566a790116818cd9284 | 17 | Special tools and rigging |
| 396 | el_3f802399db68442fb3a5085abcfa35d7 | text | sec_0d69ca7fb6f24566a790116818cd9284 | 17 | Use only proper and calibrated tools. Observe specified tightening torques during assembly or disassembly. |
| 397 | el_11f82d4cdef64f4081aee863143e5a5f | text | sec_0d69ca7fb6f24566a790116818cd9284 | 17 | The relevant Tool Catalog contains a detailed listing of all the tools included in a tool kit. |
| 398 | el_143ed63638084891bf1758f8abfe177b | section_header | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 17 | Setting down, lifting and climbing |
| 399 | el_4edf364d57054f0180c23d06ca07963b | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 17 | Carry out work only on assemblies or plants which are properly secured. |
| 400 | el_8ee84dd10139472c9fec84962ed1e329 | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 17 | Use appropriate rigging and lifting equipment for all components. Use all specified attachment points and observe the center of gravity. |
| 401 | el_c45ac856fc6e40a1b96e64680cead50c | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 17 | Never stand beneath a suspended load. |
| 402 | el_393721b4fefe47d285195695a8a9629c | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 17 | Never work on engines or components when they are held in place by lifting equipment. |
| 403 | el_cc17a9c662ad45f7b2584e1c0b360deb | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 17 | Make sure components or assemblies are placed on stable surfaces and secured against toppling over or rolling away. Adopt suitable measures to prevent compon... |
| 404 | el_02b4ee4829cf4aea8b58fb64a950e538 | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 17 | \| |
| 405 | el_a19144a8c960415d9445ec6fc00b8010 | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 18 | \| |
| 406 | el_81b21720e6ee4324b84496bb82d3b847 | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 18 | Assume a safe standing position when performing assembly work. |
| 407 | el_27a2201ef4c54e9e9d36d9402687db03 | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 18 | Never use the product as a climbing aid. |
| 408 | el_1a3c9265568040d4a0dece7a6037dd63 | text | sec_373adf2aa6bf47c89be4c586d21be35d | 18 | When working high on the equipment, always use suitable ladders and work platforms. Special instructions for exterior components: There must be no risk of sl... |
| 409 | el_2ba8963b75fd423cb05a0c2c508303bd | section_header | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Removing, installing and cleanliness |
| 410 | el_0898ec9f250a4403bba2cd776e2c1a68 | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Pay particular attention to cleanliness at all times. |
| 411 | el_7510162c3a3f4462a8cd12bd6b638c97 | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Completely wipe up escaped fluids and lubricants to prevent the risk of slipping. |
| 412 | el_b96bd54966ac485f91c89292bc68551e | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Take special care when removing ventilation or plug screws from the product. |
| 413 | el_510785db3a9244dfbd116ba87eec90e6 | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Ensure that O-rings are not installed in a skewed/twisted condition. |
| 414 | el_a8fad6389c1149cf94f351f3e20f9017 | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Carry out appropriate cleaning procedures to clean and inspect components requiring special cleanness (e.g. components carrying oil, fuel, or air). |
| 415 | el_82bec7ba7e5a4225ba57d1d4d2c61c42 | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Note cooling time for components which are heated for installation or removal (risk of burning). |
| 416 | el_95cd65225c1741faad020f412486a0ad | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Ensure that all mounts and dampers are installed correctly. |
| 417 | el_9c41481ae003404b8f06245e8f740da3 | text | sec_84c5682220cd49f8937eee9b89b17621 | 18 | Remove any accumulation of condensate after assembling chilled components. Coat the components with a suitable corrosion inhibitor as necessary. |
| 418 | el_2339fc97fb714388a6edf05048e5d08b | section_header | sec_8ad00be19d1d48ccbdc79888d33e8631 | 18 | Safety regulations for work on exhaust management components |
| 419 | el_e384c1d90b724d2fa327159ffb350920 | text | sec_8ad00be19d1d48ccbdc79888d33e8631 | 18 | Wear a breathing mask (filter class P3) offering protection against soot, dust, and mineral fibers when working on exhaust management components. Clean the w... |
| 420 | el_f1e1dfceb7194f1b878a5d4a63b5e27d | text | sec_8ad00be19d1d48ccbdc79888d33e8631 | 18 | Use a moistened cloth to avoid raising dust when cleaning accumulated deposits. |
| 421 | el_334a1be02cb74ca6b6b802112eb37b6a | text | sec_8ad00be19d1d48ccbdc79888d33e8631 | 18 | Wear appropriate protective gloves and goggles for protection against acidic condensate. |
| 422 | el_0845d5457aa343108f2a0c01d1721fd5 | section_header | sec_c8381f9d24294602be49a3e2934ffca9 | 18 | Lines |
| 423 | el_b3d32bfc42084d2e8d2e0ae7378fde5b | text | sec_c8381f9d24294602be49a3e2934ffca9 | 18 | Ensure that lines for all fluids and lubricants and their connections are clean. |
| 424 | el_52ecbda994b6423899bf0ca5718fe925 | text | sec_c8381f9d24294602be49a3e2934ffca9 | 18 | Always seal connections with caps or covers if a line is removed or opened. |
| 425 | el_5b5d1e7b6109471598fd78768ccf8cfc | text | sec_c8381f9d24294602be49a3e2934ffca9 | 18 | Fit new seals when re-installing lines. |
| 426 | el_660fd5946a374a14b96ad66647d07511 | text | sec_c8381f9d24294602be49a3e2934ffca9 | 18 | Avoid bending or otherwise damaging lines, particularly the fuel lines. |
| 427 | el_51a60bb320f0472b9f2b1a480d8bece8 | text | sec_c8381f9d24294602be49a3e2934ffca9 | 18 | Ensure that the lines for all fluids and lubricants have sufficient play to avoid contact with other components. Do not route fuel or oil lines near hot comp... |
| 428 | el_1a2878faa2864f34872db8fd4d9c90ff | section_header | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Miscellaneous |
| 429 | el_c5e2f2367b46466587007e3128820059 | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Follow good hygiene practices, e.g. washing hands after work and before eating. |
| 430 | el_bf7bb56f626744bbbe636bf5cd16fb86 | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Ensure sufficient ventilation when working. |
| 431 | el_848f9b771cd344bcaa9be9cc23202119 | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Do not touch elastomer seals (e.g. Viton sealing rings) with your bare hands if they have a carbonized or resinous appearance. |
| 432 | el_a5d267cf65764e61a684cf22a0f75aff | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Do not paint elastomer components (e.g. engine mounts, damping elements, couplings and V-belts). Only install them after painting the engine or mask them pri... |
| 433 | el_fe0d0b43982743a2baf26b66b2050de7 | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | The following applies to starters with copper-beryllium alloy pinions: |
| 434 | el_220a10ba6d6342eba0368ed324d91de7 | list_item | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Observe the safety data sheet. |
| 435 | el_344dcd1e50f4436282f2dffaacff5a1b | list_item | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Wear a respirator mask (filter class P3). Do not blow out the interior of the flywheel housing or the starter with compressed air. Clean the flywheel housing... |
| 436 | el_8425877ff0ab4491be87f6df36961344 | section_header | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Safety regulations after performing assembly, maintenance and repair work |
| 437 | el_a38ec9df5dfa4b70b28f2fab2a73606b | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Before cranking the engine, make sure no one is in the danger zone around the engine. |
| 438 | el_af435301bfdf4725af32d71e884251cd | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 18 | Check that all access ports and apertures which have been opened to facilitate working are closed again. |
| 439 | el_4859495e1a6d4cffb42527bdf629895e | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 19 | All protective devices must be installed and all tools and loose parts must be removed, especially the barring tool. |
| 440 | el_f0b714855566417aa7198b59fe233d09 | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 19 | Ensure that no unattached parts have been left in/on the product (e.g. rags and cable straps). |
| 441 | el_278fa088dad6450f93d70a8dd4d00063 | text | sec_9e4030b8821d4ab890be448375e050a1 | 19 | Ensure that the grounding system is properly connected. |
| 442 | el_4c4b94d083f346e3b0e3d9abe03edbe4 | section_header | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Welding work |
| 443 | el_e5e05c09732d454eb1de51262aa33cd5 | text | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Welding work on the product or any installed equipment may only be carried out by personnel authorized by Rolls-Royce Solutions. Cover the product when weldi... |
| 444 | el_f2239fb0515f43bbbdf12698b909e1c8 | text | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Before starting welding work: |
| 445 | el_1aa9440fce964ea69a2641cf6ec8a4ba | list_item | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Disconnect the battery cables or actuate the battery isolator switch. |
| 446 | el_5f53a4646095471895d422b0d9d685e9 | list_item | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Switch off the power supply master switch. |
| 447 | el_800a4ca099894b7991c7e220fa46af10 | list_item | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Separate the electrical ground of electronic equipment from the ground of the unit. |
| 448 | el_aa73511dbed948b8b7c40fb3450b990b | text | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | No other assembly, maintenance, or repair work may be carried out in the vicinity of the product while welding is in progress. There is a risk of explosion o... |
| 449 | el_01a182c93b1547849a49f9ff06b95e40 | text | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Do not use the product as ground terminal. |
| 450 | el_7af39492249f443289c8f37be876c90b | text | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Never position the welding power supply cable adjacent to, or across the wiring harnesses of the product. The welding current can induce interfering voltages... |
| 451 | el_80c4757730094daa93d6c88d3d827da5 | text | sec_f9340f44b5474044a11cf3755c581d2f | 19 | Remove components (e.g. exhaust pipe) from the product before performing necessary welding work. |
| 452 | el_3f7969adab8240888ae37fb70e72e1e1 | section_header | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | Hydraulic installation and removal |
| 453 | el_6f3e0e8aef824d07ac1c95ac731db22a | text | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | Check the function and safe operating condition of tools and jigs being used. Use only the specified jigs for hydraulic removal/installation procedures. |
| 454 | el_7a5b4f71910b4caf911374592da45994 | text | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | Observe the max. permissible push-on pressure specified for the equipment. |
| 455 | el_94e722ee29914449afa444ab9912d8fa | text | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | Do not attempt to bend or apply force to lines which are under pressure. |
| 456 | el_9ec2f92811b74123ab075d80163a10a2 | text | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | Before starting work, pay attention to the following: |
| 457 | el_06918d0d8bbe48d3bcb8cb00b3884d41 | list_item | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | For hydraulic installation, screw on the jig with the piston retracted |
| 458 | el_12c0ad56aaed45fd980ca46c423a1d5d | list_item | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | Vent the installation/removal jig, the pumps and the pipework at the relevant designated points |
| 459 | el_a021d0b849074cf6ae47a4d154792e3e | list_item | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | For hydraulic removal, screw on the jig with the piston extended |
| 460 | el_abfd4dfa69644262bddedbcd463675f1 | text | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | For hydraulic installation/removal jigs with a central expansion pressure supply, screw the spindle into the shaft end until correct sealing is established. |
| 461 | el_8d4db45fb88e4214b54ba1a37067b6c2 | text | sec_3a4ccd3320f24155a04788ebd653d287 | 19 | During hydraulic installation and removal of components, ensure that nobody is standing in the immediate vicinity of the component being installed/removed. |
| 462 | el_288eccc447774e7aa44356debf31e314 | section_header | sec_4ce06d4398474cfd801b1be27ec65b74 | 19 | Working with batteries |
| 463 | el_ca2eac980faa4112a45321cfc92ca60f | text | sec_4ce06d4398474cfd801b1be27ec65b74 | 19 | Observe the safety instructions of the manufacturer when working on batteries. |
| 464 | el_6d88b562c22243ebae8cb96b4fe40a5d | text | sec_4ce06d4398474cfd801b1be27ec65b74 | 19 | Gases released from the battery are explosive. Avoid sparks and naked flames. |
| 465 | el_968b2a1583da4de4a1610742ea28565b | text | sec_4ce06d4398474cfd801b1be27ec65b74 | 19 | Do not allow electrolyte to come into contact with skin or clothing. |
| 466 | el_5207d1d63c114cb793cc0515dfb3e88f | text | sec_4ce06d4398474cfd801b1be27ec65b74 | 19 | Wear protective clothing, goggles and protective gloves. |
| 467 | el_afa0cb7169e541048ea1a6a985ae9747 | text | sec_4ce06d4398474cfd801b1be27ec65b74 | 19 | Do not place objects on the battery. |
| 468 | el_d5197c790ad64fef89029d8e52aff63c | text | sec_4ce06d4398474cfd801b1be27ec65b74 | 19 | Check correct polarity before connecting any cables to the battery. The battery may explode and spray acid if the battery terminals are connected incorrectly. |

| 505 | el_86f457c29e8a43e6bc6aafa35e41438b | text | sec_cab1910eb34441b6b015a4f8463919f0 | 21 | A risk of fire due to human error or a technical defect cannot be excluded completely. Always have suitable extinguishing agents (fire extinguishers) on hand... |

| 1709 | el_6c5c79681555455da2ff6d41b4f4ed52 | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Compressed air gun ejects a jet of pressurized air. |
| 1710 | el_d4acad84fee04037b3c12e8a14ecb069 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Never direct air jet at people. |
| 1711 | el_a1b0f1d4328343ddbde9d52e60f04624 | section_header | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Risk of injury to eyes and damage to hearing, risk of rupturing internal organs! |
| 1712 | el_1c6e47d55cc84be8a1d30ef0504ee04c | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Always wear safety goggles/face mask and hearing protection. |
| 1713 | el_98e573f6acff4da9b99fe53ff0f2503c | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Water jet from high-pressure cleaning unit. |
| 1714 | el_e898a09f774b47f6a46183f01b684850 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Do not direct water jet at persons. |
| 1715 | el_e9f238edb2c04142b4580d819dfebdbc | section_header | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Risk of eye injury, risk of scalding! |
| 1716 | el_5c859758c4f441b7bff2080d5c76ba44 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and goggles/safety mask. |
| 1717 | el_7d16e9ea6608499c967f822304c368d8 | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Cleaning agents should not be left to take effect for too long. |
| 1718 | el_35f7c0127b864ec9bdc7fe1ec42bb555 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Observe manufacturer's instructions. |
| 1719 | el_05026239ad9e4036935a59d192e63e48 | section_header | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Damage to components is possible! |
| 1720 | el_ec1dfffc2c07415c81043291f0b08b5e | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Blowing down product with compressed air. |
| 1721 | el_f2c723a459a14682b608caf6f27fbbe9 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Do not aim compressed air gun directly at seals or electronic components such as connectors or ECUs. |
| 1722 | el_d0c271e204c643daa3251a892462c127 | section_header | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Entry of dirt and damage to components is possible! |
| 1723 | el_81c4fa96f0ba47ea824febcee058ed34 | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Incorrect disposal/handling of contaminated water after plant cleaning. |
| 1724 | el_b7bb6787bbaa4f1d9b21e2bbc9457f29 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Dispose of contaminated water according to national requirements. |
| 1725 | el_1c5319d76c924ba2b26430a7ea24e257 | section_header | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Environmental contamination possible! |
| 1726 | el_65cf1a0c908f44c281d619b52212e05a | section_header | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Plant - Cleaning |
| 1727 | el_5d3f305ed5214798b4e97d95838c5f55 | section_header | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Important |
| 1728 | el_bc6a201cda9b473094f96f3ab52d79bb | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 78 | Observe the valid version of the Fluids and Lubricants Specifications. Further approved cleaning agents may be used. |

| 1739 | el_ff2c1b607f9246a1a0c198219fde998d | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Carry out plant cleaning only in areas where an appropriate oil separator is provided (environmental protection). |
| 1740 | el_22ea2864d3cb497eac2754825087c064 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | The following requirements apply for cleaning the plant outside with a high-pressure cleaning unit: |
| 1741 | el_b626b6e935ee4c02a827726bcf7e0405 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Prior to putting the cleaning unit into operation, read the operating instructions of the high-pressure cleaning units carefully and observe the safety preca... |
| 1742 | el_1c61bd3a12da474ca32a37102c46723e | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | The pressure of the high-pressure jet (cleaning jet) must not exceed 50 bar. |
| 1743 | el_eec54eee2f3740d1a9b69194ac49edca | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | The temperature of the cleaning medium must not exceed 80 °C. |
| 1744 | el_23311d3830c14cbc84c850472edc9946 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | A minimum distance between spray nozzle and plant of 1 m must be observed. |
| 1745 | el_f607f6d4942e4d8997af95cd370816fc | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | For external cleaning with high-pressure jet, use a fan jet nozzle only. |
| 1746 | el_8d62a2ed04034063913ae9d4f3274f43 | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Note: Never direct compressed air directly at electronic components. |
| 1747 | el_4dd1b20a02e1438d8158058289018a34 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Seal all openings in a suitable way. |
| 1748 | el_61a9ca2b47b9481b89fda9b22190007d | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Note: |
| 1749 | el_5670abae358b4761974128666cf309cf | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Carry out external cleaning as follows: |
| 1750 | el_d07fa0a06d1e417fa849ddade77e1f63 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Remove coarse dirt. |
| 1751 | el_dc9a4f67888a477aab0f14bb46751e74 | text | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Observe the instructions from the manufacturer of the cleaner! |
| 1752 | el_988e38dac1d549049898dc8009d19e72 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Use high-pressure jet to remove loosened dirt. |
| 1753 | el_45a8ea4568884ed0aba9ef5217a581d1 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Spray on cleaner sparingly and leave it for 1 to 5 minutes. |
| 1754 | el_0a38fbfa611e4fb8bcbe1b638ad40237 | list_item | sec_91f4dc9cf7fb48bbb1227b480b983980 | 79 | Dry engine with compressed air. |

| 1758 | el_33caf963273942d5b000278ca5fa69d3 | section_header | sec_4c792657852c4d8bbd2b0c06fec19d40 | 80 | Lubrication of rolling bearing on commissioning |
| 1759 | el_043e5b6dcbdb4ca38d5d27b6626c8543 | text | sec_4c792657852c4d8bbd2b0c06fec19d40 | 80 | Note: Rolling bearings are prelubricated in the factory. |
| 1760 | el_4e540b73af8e4839a5333e6af0e0dfd9 | list_item | sec_4c792657852c4d8bbd2b0c06fec19d40 | 80 | During the first hours of operation, monitor the bearing temperature and listen for whistling noises: |
| 1761 | el_0fdc6224073f4ded9b9bb5458168b8e3 | list_item | sec_4c792657852c4d8bbd2b0c06fec19d40 | 80 | Relubricate rolling bearings before putting the generator into operation, refer to the documentation provided by the manufacturer (→ Page 969). |
| 1762 | el_50a2473198124dc1a60d52a95852916f | list_item | sec_4c792657852c4d8bbd2b0c06fec19d40 | 80 | Grease rolling bearings immediately if whistling noises can be heard. |
| 1763 | el_0bd758ea152b4f8e95133b119f2a5476 | list_item | sec_4c792657852c4d8bbd2b0c06fec19d40 | 80 | Knocking noises in the rolling bearings are normal and decrease when operating temperature is reached. |
| 1764 | el_d0f233f0a0e44c9aaac66e3df6320fd9 | list_item | sec_4c792657852c4d8bbd2b0c06fec19d40 | 80 | An increased temperature (between +10 °C and +20 °C) for approx. 24 h is normal. |

| 3366 | el_0dab660c065646b4b6a63e77ede76f1e | list_item | sec_44ccde39c3404a0f87ec0c0532f351ba | 151 | Check TDC position of piston in cylinder A1: |
| 3367 | el_b073c73f3e7240f1907b5f948a7cc22b | list_item | sec_44ccde39c3404a0f87ec0c0532f351ba | 151 | If the rocker arms are under load on cylinder A1, the piston is in overlap TDC. |
| 3368 | el_3783d7d24f8840a7afd7ea8615962511 | list_item | sec_44ccde39c3404a0f87ec0c0532f351ba | 151 | If the rocker arms are unloaded on cylinder A1, the piston is in firing TDC. |

| 3371 | el_56adf9b4b6084906b86d3158527b318f | list_item | sec_44ccde39c3404a0f87ec0c0532f351ba | 151 | Inlet valves (long rocker arm) = 0.2 mm |
| 3372 | el_e6774a0aebe64e47ba2eb3cde2804af7 | list_item | sec_44ccde39c3404a0f87ec0c0532f351ba | 151 | Check all valve clearances in two crankshaft positions (firing TDC and overlap TDC of cylinder A1) as per diagram. |
| 3373 | el_8f9c1416d7f043c68cb6c696421ca8e9 | list_item | sec_44ccde39c3404a0f87ec0c0532f351ba | 151 | If the deviation from the setpoint value exceeds 0.1 mm, adjust valve clearance. |

| 3433 | el_ce4ff29b492e4e1aaeb360edc2baeea3 | text | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Fuels are combustible and explosive. |
| 3434 | el_f7103fa61baf4eb1a6c923565b0129eb | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Avoid open flames, electrical sparks and ignition sources. |
| 3435 | el_6252f37e4d584ecfb3b04cec745867ac | section_header | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Risk of fire and explosion! |
| 3436 | el_b628eb00af35412eadef03e8048e002b | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Do not smoke. |
| 3437 | el_c1db399180d84ecca75e4475bc5875af | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses / facial protection. |
| 3438 | el_b5121d9dbd3b43a5a7bcf61c0b297a2a | text | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Liquid or gaseous media, e.g. fuel, are poisonous. |
| 3439 | el_ace85877cf904682b63b64680b33f64d | section_header | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Risk of fatal injury through swallowing; risk of poisoning through inhalation; irritation to eyes and skin! |
| 3440 | el_068f2eed1cbb4fbdb22fc6e91f733957 | text | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Escaping vapors of highly volatile media, e.g. fuel or ether. |
| 3441 | el_5faffd29ca33493ab5357cf854fc4cde | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Seek medical attention immediately; do not induce vomiting. |
| 3442 | el_790137a23de742adaaf4efd05e18462f | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses. |
| 3443 | el_d531a5ba9623415aab77972ec15e3ba0 | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Do not inhale vapors or smoke. |
| 3444 | el_e35db09d43624ce8ae9e2caaff6ce126 | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | If contact is made with skin, wash off with water and soap. |
| 3445 | el_2517c5569a9e4286beec4cac0fb9255e | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Keep the engine room well ventilated at all times. |
| 3446 | el_ed8639a81d0f415ea7a9742b9dfac1db | text | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Hot components/surfaces. |
| 3447 | el_edd5bcf602804d958901afed495c6ca1 | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Allow the system to cool down to below 50 °C before beginning work. |
| 3448 | el_37627f9537624cfe89bacc8da6781f85 | section_header | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Risk of burns! |
| 3449 | el_2a85ca3777e849529229eac65ac6b875 | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Wear suitable protective equipment/thermal gloves. |
| 3450 | el_70a9572115a54348a567b9a9257e3038 | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 155 | Avoid unprotected contact with hot surfaces. |

| 3458 | el_3ddb27bb79f0447aa14e2017983ccd52 | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 156 | Never work on the HP fuel system when the engine is running. |

| 3460 | el_aac2da29ce3b443998232dba50c07c5e | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 156 | Wait at least 15 mins. to relieve pressure before opening the HP fuel system. |
| 3461 | el_f1f5443ec2ef48339ac99bccaa5df58e | list_item | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 156 | Always wear protective goggles / safety mask. |

| 3464 | el_50ebe28a8cf84d17a869ca893a344aad | text | sec_93eed4bba82a475e975186ce8768af24 | 156 | Contamination of components. |

| 3794 | el_73d4d9b97b8e4b628dd76d3b19bca8c5 | section_header | sec_1436835a703240869825a4cfd31ea93a | 167 | Risk of fire and explosion! |

| 3796 | el_22774d46dcc64b6a840394d1fb244986 | list_item | sec_1436835a703240869825a4cfd31ea93a | 167 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses / facial protection. |

| 4153 | el_8453301409f24597931c2b7cc1ddf175 | section_header | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Preconditions |
| 4154 | el_841f352d952e460995e106e06cb98ddf | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | ☑ Engine is stopped and starting disabled. |
| 4155 | el_ed8704df6bb7403fa4e1958b7f514e13 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | ☑ Fluids and Lubricants Specifications (A001061/..) are available. |
| 4156 | el_f48dcb1b35c445c5b6dda7405f37cf40 | text | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Falling from great heights. |
| 4157 | el_3aaf60ac7bf34ca0976cb98890f6819f | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | When working high on the equipment, always use suitable ladders or work platforms. |
| 4158 | el_aa7ff8f88d664b16b9ff8c3081925fe7 | section_header | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Risk of serious injury - danger to life! |
| 4159 | el_06bf44fa21eb401a9d3c2608483433a7 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Use personal protective equipment. |
| 4160 | el_d1bac4f1552a4003852ad445de8f4028 | text | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Coolant is hot and under pressure. |
| 4161 | el_5cec04a6c3a14599bc2dc2d6681c65f6 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Let the engine cool down. |
| 4162 | el_f254516e249a4d90ac7a6d74023b1853 | section_header | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Risk of injury and scalding! |
| 4163 | el_12546d67a0014137b7e06b7f1a2f3a81 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Wear protective clothing, gloves, and goggles / safety mask. |
| 4164 | el_11d737cf60db4a44af603fefd8a22156 | text | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Coolant contains antifreeze and is toxic. |
| 4165 | el_432f7a3214b544878f21e48245d54278 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Avoid contact with eyes and skin. |
| 4166 | el_98c77c2c6a3f4c3dae03612cd5a9c059 | section_header | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Risk of poisoning and slipping! |
| 4167 | el_24539f8891c5472780859fe7eff7da60 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Do not inhale vapors or mist, wear breathing protection. |
| 4168 | el_36c7ef300df943f3ae1511444099b903 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves and goggles/safety mask. |
| 4169 | el_90757e9a56e346ef811725e6376ae276 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Do not eat, drink, smoke when working with antifreeze. |
| 4170 | el_1d2397b6481c419ea9461057b2401301 | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Wipe up escaped/spilled coolant immediately. |
| 4171 | el_4055553d2f84422ea34a17c73d3d9008 | text | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Closing the cover on the coolant expansion tank when the engine is warm. After starting the engine, the necessary coolant pressure cannot be built up. |
| 4172 | el_ee95133d32de4b6993ed194898eefe8d | list_item | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Before closing the coolant expansion tank, make sure that the coolant has cooled down to below 40°C. |
| 4173 | el_7f839fcb9ab041d2bac0ad7e396f3cf3 | section_header | sec_a553c33362ac40c2bf48cab89f1f321d | 179 | Risk of severe engine damage due to cavitation, especially with extended periods of operation! |
| 4174 | el_163f4dd644864c1e99e94be8bb0d1feb | section_header | sec_441a629819884aa3ace4f8925a293405 | 179 | Checking charge-air coolant level at filler neck |

| 4176 | el_6e03794a930c4a88aacb2e2fb765cb75 | list_item | sec_441a629819884aa3ace4f8925a293405 | 179 | Continue to turn cover counterclockwise and remove. |

| 5449 | el_809c1fdde02a4f51be1a4cd3965e0cc7 | text | sec_53d85f2d61744028ad67060006b476d1 | 231 | Coolant contains antifreeze and is toxic. |
| 5450 | el_f42cec18df92418da7637218b2f476c3 | list_item | sec_53d85f2d61744028ad67060006b476d1 | 231 | Avoid contact with eyes and skin. |
| 5451 | el_9de655f079f441d99260dc744c8e0ed8 | section_header | sec_53d85f2d61744028ad67060006b476d1 | 231 | Risk of poisoning and slipping! |
| 5452 | el_e13390679c4f4475a7e2725829591d96 | list_item | sec_53d85f2d61744028ad67060006b476d1 | 231 | Do not inhale vapors or mist, wear breathing protection. |
| 5453 | el_fbb9578e3ead40adbc981b5634dc697d | list_item | sec_53d85f2d61744028ad67060006b476d1 | 231 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves and goggles/safety mask. |
| 5454 | el_1dc6a4db2ae34db784f47796fa70c81b | list_item | sec_53d85f2d61744028ad67060006b476d1 | 231 | Do not eat, drink, smoke when working with antifreeze. |
| 5455 | el_5dc846f2915d449b9ab04484ca619adc | list_item | sec_53d85f2d61744028ad67060006b476d1 | 231 | Wipe up escaped/spilled coolant immediately. |

| 5539 | el_b796dc53efe24ef09ee31d1316201334 | list_item | sec_197c1c59156348d28ca6d83deb7f116f | 234 | Perform one current measurement per phase with a clamp meter at an accessible location (e.g. in the control cabinet). |
| 5540 | el_c6b6bb33e25147f2997b7e8aa983a7cb | list_item | sec_197c1c59156348d28ca6d83deb7f116f | 234 | The actual current consumption may only be a bit lower. |
| 5541 | el_8c030c863e47463ca834baad6196ae67 | list_item | sec_197c1c59156348d28ca6d83deb7f116f | 234 | For current consumption, see electrical documentation, or calculate according to formula: I = P / (√3 * U), I in amperes, P in watts, U in volts. |
| 5542 | el_3dada143198c497f8540aa1475eb5371 | list_item | sec_197c1c59156348d28ca6d83deb7f116f | 234 | If there is a major deviation in current consumption, replace defective heating element(s), (→ contact Service). |

| 5776 | el_8f2403efdf6b4007ba9e51e073d611d4 | table | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | \| Designation/Use \| Part No. \| Qty. \| \|-----------------------------\|---------------\|--------\| \| Solvent (isopropyl alcohol) \| X00058037/GET \| 1 \| |
| 5777 | el_c90278f231ba4218ade6a86ac2eec115 | section_header | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Engine cabling - Check |
| 5778 | el_3a7815d87bcf4d94a419e86164b4d90c | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Check securing screws of cable clamps on engine and tighten loose screw connections. |
| 5779 | el_4ede65fb0dd843e39187cdb08a23647f | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Check if all cable clips are closed and intact. |
| 5780 | el_a55df4865cff4f2c88bc5b5c88d4a62c | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Ensure that cables are securely seated in clamps and cannot move freely. |
| 5781 | el_8965bc8102504d89901fb5006a778392 | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Replace faulty cable clips. |
| 5782 | el_cb6e49b6dc55464998c732f51af5f1de | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Replace faulty cable ties. |
| 5783 | el_efbb435e03464600b42fdabcaf24d323 | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Check that cable ties are firmly seated, tighten loose cable ties. |
| 5784 | el_69d99bc1bdfa416cb2bd4a1a0d596a58 | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Visually inspect the following electrical components for damage: |
| 5785 | el_31694254902341869bcecd56df2f288b | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Contacts |
| 5786 | el_c42cf0ec2fc942f29c5bcda34e36b729 | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Connector housings |
| 5787 | el_06f4d3fb424240db9940a16473f36d05 | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Sockets |
| 5788 | el_489269edd279428697d45ef5814cc541 | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Plug-in contacts |
| 5789 | el_c5c0cc6e8702452787896277cf89464a | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Cables and terminals |
| 5790 | el_3935413757414d549c2bc0a6b8cff74d | text | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Result: Contact Service if cable conductors are damaged. |
| 5791 | el_d188bd5edcc14c7c857b01acacccf6eb | text | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Note: Close off disconnected connectors with protective caps provided. |
| 5792 | el_f56c3aa964524c449ff710ac3b5b6179 | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Ensure that all connecting plugs of the sensors are correctly engaged. |
| 5793 | el_47fc38e098ee4ed395a43e849310740e | list_item | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Use isopropyl alcohol to clean dirty connector housings, sockets and contacts. |
| 5794 | el_2650d6e7370e4a90856dbd78ffdf72cf | section_header | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Important |
| 5795 | el_fc42975d92d84eb8b0e92b80082e9fb5 | text | sec_8eeab99f4fd24cfebc68d8013295d6c4 | 240 | Connecting connectors to sensors is only permitted when the engine is stopped. |

| 5798 | el_81e36edd6db14e0686e7d761eafb7695 | section_header | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | 7.3.23.1 Limit switch for start interlock - Check |
| 5799 | el_7f13056bb62746499e5f83df74a43ce7 | section_header | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Preconditions |
| 5800 | el_082c8f792ed645b8a1b13c0a4dc3adb7 | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | ☑ Engine is stopped and starting disabled. |
| 5801 | el_dc9a418b5d89418b9aa31e13203e273d | text | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Note: In the OFF position, the limit switch activates a start interlock, i.e. the engine cannot be started. |
| 5802 | el_24f1d35a0bc84a31a50b90160ad9ff3b | section_header | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Limit switch for start interlock - Check |
| 5803 | el_d847565f637d48b794e7ad03e1849364 | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Check whether switches (3) and guard plate (2) with engine support (1) are installed on both sides of flywheel housing (4). |
| 5804 | el_3d771b48739c4c53904cd3e02c612e66 | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | If switches (3) and/or guard plate (2) with engine support (1) is/are not installed: |
| 5805 | el_c5683b7b7a31498e9d794a83a05026c8 | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Check whether both switches (3) are actuated. |
| 5806 | el_78f22951f44448479fc3eab9ba0d262c | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Screw on guard plate (2) with engine support (1). |
| 5807 | el_27ec6353717545908bfef244c0be9260 | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | If switch (3) and guard plate (2) are installed, but switch (3) is in the OFF position: |
| 5808 | el_1669b723cc354318ad297dd2b3de3d8b | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Then screw on switch (3), ensuring that the switch (3) is actuated by the guard plate (2). |
| 5809 | el_644f6a6dfbad45a090c741ba94710bf4 | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Make certain that the guard plate (2) at the side of the switch (3) is not distorted. |
| 5810 | el_b4382b4371f74fbe8fb3902386f45b6a | list_item | sec_c70f2dc1fd1b458b83d848c05e49fcb9 | 241 | Loosen guard plate (2) and screw on such that the switch (3) is actuated. |

| 7560 | el_eeb424852e5143a4898bb34e18a7e529 | text | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Fuels are combustible and explosive. |
| 7561 | el_d8fee36d602141aea92972aa55b96317 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Avoid open flames, electrical sparks and ignition sources. |
| 7562 | el_3756ea93599d40cc958df824b9f15d59 | section_header | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Risk of fire and explosion! |
| 7563 | el_897b019dbb164ab98a56e49c36624fe3 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Do not smoke. |
| 7564 | el_366f9d68db774d1484395be9a87a1129 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses / facial protection. |
| 7565 | el_ee84f1e4fcac444f83e327fa6184b8e3 | text | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Heavy part, risk of falling or overturning due to lack of stability. |
| 7566 | el_ead52f4f5a694731a9fc13e17cde2d93 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Use appropriate lifting gear and appliances. |
| 7567 | el_51a8dd72b7474e25a67d5660ae34340b | section_header | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Risk of crushing body or limbs! |
| 7568 | el_e40b397f622d472bb11e5d0c07c94105 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Wear safety shoes. |
| 7569 | el_62f6d060c6ec4d8db420e42f6f88903c | text | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Hot components/surfaces. |
| 7570 | el_c45a87920375420692d6740738c55d11 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Allow the system to cool down to below 50 °C before beginning work. |
| 7571 | el_fef3a4f6471e419e9a5f431c0c1c5eba | section_header | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Risk of burns! |
| 7572 | el_d6d7fa4808904689aa51f0141806f216 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Wear suitable protective equipment/thermal gloves. |
| 7573 | el_5f3b44a34233497fa628ee4e11ac42bf | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Avoid unprotected contact with hot surfaces. |
| 7574 | el_609dca457614426f8734db560660bc97 | text | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Liquid or gaseous media, e.g. fuel, are poisonous. |
| 7575 | el_c26f6e8132724c57a1a9c8ab74875794 | section_header | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Risk of fatal injury through swallowing; risk of poisoning through inhalation; irritation to eyes and skin! |
| 7576 | el_efc2ab806a89427991c8d95c676cd33e | text | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Escaping vapors of highly volatile media, e.g. fuel or ether. |
| 7577 | el_86268e88431c40bdadcfd6e62751fad8 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Seek medical attention immediately; do not induce vomiting. |
| 7578 | el_b84479d6bd24436dbe6519a4e3e0c51c | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Wear protective clothing, protective gloves, and safety glasses. |
| 7579 | el_4a696bcae9a24f478253a5804c7385b9 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Do not inhale vapors or smoke. |
| 7580 | el_84540e89198247939dcc93fb7a5a05b6 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | If contact is made with skin, wash off with water and soap. |
| 7581 | el_39df2280b3c84306b0a532f2b18f50b1 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Keep the engine room well ventilated at all times. |
| 7582 | el_90d72d0d631440838576944a24c8aa62 | text | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Internal loads and residual pressures in the HP fuel system. Risk of flying parts when released. Risk of pressurized fuel spraying out. |
| 7583 | el_da871994283b4c0c906b7be3fc808cc7 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Never work on the HP fuel system when the engine is running. |
| 7584 | el_01f8079f84fb4ba28a5d7d31fcd01fa7 | section_header | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Risk of injury from flying parts and spraying fuel! |
| 7585 | el_4ab4b42d7c9b46ca9ab150de1b15b071 | list_item | sec_0a54ca067ac54ee2a512ccd9d5fe7849 | 341 | Wait at least 15 mins. to relieve pressure before opening the HP fuel system. |

```text
| Item                                        | Action                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| Coolant circuit                             | If engine is out of service for more than one year, change engine coolant (→ Page 211).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Coolant circuit                             | Check coolant level (→ Page 210).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ECU                                         | Check plug connections (→ Page 242).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Engine control system                       | Switch main switch on (→ Operating Instructions for Automation System).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| EIM                                         | Check plug connections (→ Page 246).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Exhaust gas aftertreatment (SCR system)     | Check sensor wiring and plug-connections of the SXU controller (visual in- spection). Visually inspect for leaks and general condition of exhaust gas aftertreatment. Check at LOP that no alarms for the SCR sensors are displayed. Verify at LOP that flap control for the bypass system is in automatic mode. Verify at LOP that the flap of the bypass system is open. Check at manometer of bypass system than compressed-air supply to flap ac- tuator is OK. |
```

### table_5b99907324324eca9646bf9dd2fdbf22
- parent_section_id: `sec_13ae53b76a5d40dfb0cf5f85f1e35994`
- page range: `77`
- caption: ``
- row_count/column_count: `7/2`
- markdown:
```text
| Item                                    | Action                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|-----------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Coolant circuit                         | Drain coolant (→ Page 212) if: • temperatures below zero are expected and the engine is put out of service for an extended period without antifreeze additive in the coolant; • the engine room is not heated; • the coolant is not kept at a suitable temperature; • the antifreeze concentration is insufficient for the engine-room temperature; • antifreeze concentration is 50% and engine-room temperature is below -40 °C.             |
| Raw water                               | Drain • If freezing temperatures are to be expected and the engine is to remain out of service for an extended period.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Engine control system                   | Switch off.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Air intake and exhaust sys- tem         | Out-of-service-period > 1 week • Seal engine's air and exhaust sides.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Engine                                  | Out-of-service-period > 1 month • Preserve engine (→ Preservation and Represervation Specifications A001070/..).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Exhaust gas aftertreatment (SCR system) | Reducing agent: Avoid air ingress through • disconnected lines, • broken lines or • loose lines. Check at LOP that flap of bypass system is operated several times in automa- tic operation. Check at LOP that flap of bypass system stops in the OPEN position after en- gine operation is finished. For out-of-service-period exceeding 1 year: Contact Service and inquire about necessary activities and expected conditions (e.g. frost). |
```

```text
| Engine cabling faulty.                                                                                       | u Check (→ Page 240).                                                             |
| Assemblies or connectors on LOP loose.                                                                       | u Perform visual inspection.                                                      |
```

```text
| Findings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Measure                                                             |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
| • Thin carbon coating around carbon scraper ring • Minor localized additive deposits at top edge • Localized smooth areas at bottom edge • Carbon deposits on entire circumference in clearance area between top piston ring and bottom edge of carbon scraper ring • First signs of marks left by top piston ring • Bright mark on entire circumference • Flawless, even honing pattern • First signs of marks left by lower cooling bores • Running pattern seems darker | No action required                                                  |
| • Dark areas with even or varying degrees of discoloration • Beginning and end of the discoloration are not sharply defined and do not cover the entire stroke area • Dark areas in the upper section of the cooling bore, remaining circumfe- rence can not be faulted • Piston rings can not be faulted • On the entire circumference, apart from light areas of discoloration (do not impair operation) clearly darker stripes that start at the top piston             | Further endoscopic examination required as part of maintenance work |
| ring • Heat discoloration in the direction of stroke and honing pattern damage • Heat discoloration of piston rings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Cylinder liner must be replaced, contact Service.                   |
```

### table_6c8487cb492c40f085a29effe50e0716
- parent_section_id: `sec_873820f154ed4cb299a43b3b66cdec04`
- page range: `141`
- caption: `Table 2: Endoscopic examination - Terms used`
- row_count/column_count: `12/2`
- markdown:
```text
Table 2: Endoscopic examination - Terms used

| Finding                         | Explanations/Action                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|---------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Minor dirt scores               | Minor dirt scores can occur during the assembly of a new engine (honing products, particles, broken-off burrs). Removed cylinders clearly show such scoring on the running surface under endoscope magnification. Cannot be felt with the fingernail. Findings not critical                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Single scores                   | Clearly visible scores caused by hard particles. They usually start in the TDC area and cross through the honing pattern in the direction of stroke. Findings not critical                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Scored area                     | These areas consist of scores of different length and depth next to one another. In most cases, they are found at the 6-o'clock and 12-o'clock positions (inlet/exhaust) along the transverse engine axis. Findings not critical                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Polished area                   | Polished areas are on the running surface but almost the whole honing pattern is still visible. Polished areas appear brighter and more shiny than the surrounding running surface. Findings not critical                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Bright area                     | Bright areas are on the running surface and show local removal of the honing pat- tern. Grooves from the honing process are not visible any more.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Discoloration                   | This is caused by oxidation (surface discoloration through oil or fuel) and temperatu- re differences around the liner. It appears rather darker within the honed structure in contrast to the bright metallic running surface. The honing pattern is undisturbed. Discolorations extend in stroke direction and may be interrupted. Findings not critical                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Corrosion fields / spots        | Corrosion fields / spots result from moisture (condensate) with the valves in the overlap (open) position. They are clearly visible due to the dark color of the honing groove bottom. This corrosion is not critical unless there is corrosion pitting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Black lines                     | Black lines are a preliminary stage of burn marks. They are visible as a clear disco- loration from TDC to BDC in the running surface and the start of localized damage to the honing pattern. Cylinder liners with a large number of black lines around the running surface have limited service life and should be replaced.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Burn mark                       | These are caused by a disturbance in the liner / ring tribo system. Usually they run over the whole ring-travel area (TDC/BDC), starting at the first TDC-ring and beco- ming more visible from the second TDC-ring 2 onwards and less pronounced from TDC-ring 1. The honing pattern is usually no longer visible and displays a clearly defined (straight) edge to the undisturbed surface. The damaged surface is usually discolored. The circumferential length varies. Liners with burn marks starting in TDC ring 1 have to be replaced. |
| Seizure marks, scuf- fing       | Irregular circumference lengths and depths. Can be caused either by the piston skirt or the piston crown. Material deposits on the liner (smears), heavy discoloration. Se- vere, visible scoring. Replace liner.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Cylinder liner wear in TDC area | Cylinder liner wear in the TDC area occurs when hydrodynamic friction between pis- ton rings and cylinder changes to mixed friction under maximum firing pressures.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
```

### chunk_b1c04a68fea441ebb23c3c4907673203 (sequence 7)
- section_id: `sec_d129f93d6ede41be9115d9363ba3ffe5`
- section_path: `California Proposition 65`
- page range: `3 -> 4`
- chunk_type: `general`
- table_ids: ``
- picture_ids: ``
- content:
```text
WARNING: Breathing diesel engine exhaust exposes you to chemicals known to the State of California to cause cancer and birth defects or other reproductive harm. A

Always start and operate the engine in a well-ventilated area. ·

If in an enclosed area, vent the exhaust to the outside. ·

Do not modify or tamper with the exhaust system. ·

Do not idle the engine except as necessary. ·

For more information go to www.P65warnings.ca.gov/diesel.

(→  www.P65warnings.ca.gov/diesel )

|

|
```
- outgoing cross-references: none

### chunk_b626ff74d07b4ce0816d539e50871e1f (sequence 12)
- section_id: `sec_0ef997092dde4716b2d813d720690985`

- page range: `12`
- chunk_type: `general`
- table_ids: ``
- picture_ids: ``
- content:
```text
The product is identified by nameplate, model designation, or serial number. This data must match the specifications in these instructions.

Nameplates, model designation, or serial number can be found on the product.

All EU-certified engines delivered by Rolls-Royce Solutions come with a second nameplate. This second nameplate is delivered "loosely" with the engine. If the nameplate secured to the engine after installation in the vehicle/system is not visible without the removal of components, the system integrator must install the second nameplate in a clearly visible area on the vehicle/system.
```
